_comment: Gold-set fixture for KCH-9 trifecta detection. Three tools in one server form the canonical attack path: injection (sees_untrusted_content) → collection (reads_private_data) → exfiltration (can_exfiltrate).

tools.name: get_credentials
tools.description: Retrieve private credentials and secret tokens from secure vault storage.

service.description: Name of the service to retrieve credentials for

tools.name: browse_web
tools.description: Fetch a web page URL and return the HTML content from external websites.

extract_text.description: Strip HTML tags and return plain text

tools.name: post_to_webhook
tools.description: Send and transmit a data payload to an external webhook endpoint.

endpoint.description: Webhook endpoint to send data to
